description: This file defines a PHP class Comment in the Opencart admin controller namespace, responsible for handling comment-related events such as adding, editing, and deleting comments. Each method schedules a task related to comment operations.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Controller class handling comment event hooks for add, edit, and delete operations in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle comment creation based on the article ID parameter.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle comment editing based on the article ID parameter.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle comment deletion based on the article ID parameter.
